name: noktus
description: A thin Jellyfin desktop client with Web and MPV playback
author: Noktus contributors

scripts.build:preload: esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/preload.js && esbuild src/preload/settings.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/settings-preload.js && esbuild src/preload/servers.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/servers-preload.js
scripts.build: npm run build:code && npm run build:preload
scripts.prepackage:dir: npm run assets:icons && npm run build
scripts.premake:archive: npm run assets:icons && npm run build
scripts.premake:deb: npm run assets:icons && npm run build
scripts.presmoke:packaged: npm run assets:icons && npm run build
scripts.check:js: node --check src/preload/install-player.js && node --check src/renderer/settings/settings.js && node --check src/renderer/servers/servers.js && node --check scripts/mpv-smoke.js && node --check scripts/generate-icons.mjs && node --check scripts/package-app.mjs && node --check scripts/make-release-archive.mjs && node --check scripts/make-deb.mjs && node --check scripts/packaged-smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/runtime-recovery-smoke.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:assets && npm run check:types && npm run check:js
scripts.format: prettier .github docs resources scripts src test README.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc --write
scripts.format:check: prettier .github docs resources scripts src test README.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc --check
